card.name: Words that lead into 'either/any' conditions
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'any', 'to', 'on' or a comma inside an if-condition, where the next word is likely 'any', 'either' or 'or'. Seen in 'if you have any of', 'at any time', and 'yes to' a list of questions.

modes.label: 'any' in if-clauses
modes.description: The word 'any' after 'have' or 'at' in a conditional warning or instruction.
modes.example: If you have<< any>> of these risk factors, tell your doctor

modes.label: Linking word before a choice
modes.description: A word like 'to' or 'on' after yes/affirmative, or a comma before 'or', where either of several items can satisfy the condition.
modes.example: (If the answer is 'yes'<< to>> the last two, make sure your children

modes.label: Threshold lists with or
modes.description: A comma or unit ending one threshold, just before an alternative joined by 'or'.
modes.example: level of 50 micromolar or more at 24 hours<<,>> or 5 micromolar or more

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'either', 'any' and 'or', and away from 'both' and 'everything'.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text says that any one of several conditions is enough, not all of them.
